sections.shortTitle: Sindh Regularization of Teachers Appointed On Contract Basis Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 2018
ACT XVII OF 2018
SINDH REGULARIZATION OF TEACHERS APPOINTED ON
CONTRACT BASIS ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for regularization of the
services of certain teachers appointed on contract basis in the year 2014
through the National Testing Service (NTS)
under the Teacher Recruitment Policy (TRP) 2012 and
Sindh University under TRP-2008
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th May,
2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-04/2018,
dated 16.5.2018.---The Sindh
Regularization of Teachers Appointed on Contract Basis Bill, 2018 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 18th April, 2018 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 12th May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for
regularization of the services of certain teachers appointed on contract basis
in the year 2014 through the National Testing Service (NTS) under the Teacher
Recruitment Policy (TRP) 2012 and Sindh University under TRP-2008 and to
provide for matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto;
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Regularization of Teachers appointed on Contract
Basis Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

2. Definitions.---(1) In this Act, unless context otherwise requires-
(a) "Act"
means the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973;
(b) "appointment
of a teacher on contract basis" means the appointment of a duly qualified
teacher made on contract basis;
(c) "civil
servant" shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in the Act;
(d) "Government"
means the Government of Sindh;
(e) "teacher"
means a person appointed as primary, junior and high school teacher through to
provide for regularization of the services of certain teachers appointed on
contract basis in the year 2014 through the National Testing Service (NTS)
under the Teacher Recruitment Policy (TRP) 2012 and Sindh University under
TRP-2008.

sections.description:
Regularization of services of teachers

ACT XVII OF 2018
ACT XVII OF 2018
SINDH REGULARIZATION OF TEACHERS APPOINTED ON
CONTRACT BASIS ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for regularization of the
services of certain teachers appointed on contract basis in the year 2014
through the National Testing Service (NTS)
under the Teacher Recruitment Policy (TRP) 2012 and
Sindh University under TRP-2008
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th May,
2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-04/2018,
dated 16.5.2018.---The Sindh
Regularization of Teachers Appointed on Contract Basis Bill, 2018 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 18th April, 2018 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 12th May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for
regularization of the services of certain teachers appointed on contract basis
in the year 2014 through the National Testing Service (NTS) under the Teacher
Recruitment Policy (TRP) 2012 and Sindh University under TRP-2008 and to
provide for matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto;
3. Regularization
of services of teachers.---Notwithstanding
anything contained in the Act or rules made thereunder or any decree, order or
judgment of a court, but subject to other provisions of this Act, a teacher
appointed on contract basis and holding such appointment on the commencement of
this Act, shall be deemed to have been validly appointed as teacher as a civil
servant on regular basis, with effect from the date of commencement of this
Act:
Provided
that the orders of the regularization of services of a teacher shall be issued
by the appointing authority subject to verification of his performance by
Reform Support Unit of School Education and Literacy Department, Government of
Sindh:
Provided
further that the services of a teacher shall not be regularized unless he has
completed or completes three years of his contract period and who does not
possess the qualifications prescribed for the post and his performance is not
satisfactory:
Provided
also that the transfer of any teacher, whose service is regularized, shall be
allowed only on the condition that it shall not have any adverse effect on the
working of that school and shall not disturb the specified Student Teacher
Ratio (STR).
